description: This file is a PHP plugin for the Smarty templating engine, defining the function 'smarty_function_sugar_getlink' which generates an HTML link with optional embedded image, used within the SuiteCRM project. It handles parameter validation, default setting, and delegates link creation to the SugarThemeRegistry class.

classes.name: SugarThemeRegistry
classes.description: A class responsible for managing theme-related functionalities, including generating styled links. It is referenced to obtain the current theme object and generate links.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getlink
methods.description: A Smarty plugin function that returns an HTML link, optionally with an embedded image, based on provided parameters. Validates required parameters 'url' and 'title', sets default values for optional parameters, and delegates link generation to the ThemeRegistry class.
